column8: ∀ {deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} {physical : Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCellDomain.PhysicalSnapshot} (self : Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCellDomain.Loaded deployment physical), physical.canonicalBytes (Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCellDomain.cellIdOf deployment) = Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCellDomain.cellBytes self.cell

∀ {deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} {physical : Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCellDomain.PhysicalSnapshot} (loaded : Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCellDomain.Loaded deployment physical), loaded.readGuard.expectedRoot = physical.model.roots loaded.readGuard.cellId

∀ {deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} {physical : Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCellDomain.PhysicalSnapshot} (loaded : Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCellDomain.Loaded deployment physical), Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCellDomain.cellRoot loaded.cell = physical.model.roots (Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCellDomain.cellIdOf deployment)

∀ {deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} {physical : Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCellDomain.PhysicalSnapshot} (self : Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCellDomain.Loaded deployment physical), Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCell.systemOf self.cell.logical = Option.some self.system

∀ {deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} {physical : Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCellDomain.PhysicalSnapshot} (loaded : Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCellDomain.Loaded deployment physical) (post : Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCell.Cell), (loaded.write post).expectedPre = Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCellDomain.cellRoot loaded.cell

∀ {deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} {physical : Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCellDomain.PhysicalSnapshot} (loaded : Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCellDomain.Loaded deployment physical) (post : Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCell.Cell), Minidregg.Compiler.ResourceBirthCodec.rootBytes (loaded.write post).canonicalPostBytes = (loaded.write post).exactPost
∀ {bytes : List UInt8} {cell : Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCell.Cell}, Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCellDomain.decodeCell bytes = Option.some cell → Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCellDomain.cellBytes cell = bytes

∀ (deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment) (physical : Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCellDomain.PhysicalSnapshot) (cell : Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCell.Cell) (system : Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCell.System), physical.canonicalBytes (Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCellDomain.cellIdOf deployment) = Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCellDomain.cellBytes cell → Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCell.systemOf cell.logical = Option.some system → ∃ loaded, Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCellDomain.load deployment physical = Option.some loaded ∧ loaded.cell = cell ∧ loaded.system = system

∀ (deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment) (physical : Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCellDomain.PhysicalSnapshot), Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCellDomain.decodeCell (physical.canonicalBytes (Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCellDomain.cellIdOf deployment)) = Option.none → Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCellDomain.load deployment physical = Option.none

{deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} → {physical : Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCellDomain.PhysicalSnapshot} → (cell : Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCell.Cell) → (system : Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCell.System) → physical.canonicalBytes (Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCellDomain.cellIdOf deployment) = Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCellDomain.cellBytes cell → Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCell.systemOf cell.logical = Option.some system → Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCellDomain.Loaded deployment physical
